recognize_zh: 中央一顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞質泡沫狀且帶紫紅色顆粒，內含一顆被透明空泡包圍的小淋巴球/有核細胞、一顆較大的有核細胞以及核碎片，即吞噬血球現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant foamy, finely vacuolated pale cytoplasm containing scattered pink-red granules
Engulfed small round dark nucleated cell (lymphocyte or erythroblast) surrounded by a clear phagocytic halo
Additional ingested larger nucleated cell and nuclear debris within the cytoplasm
Histiocyte nucleus not clearly identified separately from the ingested cells in this plane
Background of red cells, a myelocyte-like granulocyte and small lymphocytes; smear is thick with some drying artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant foamy vacuolated cytoplasm that contains an engulfed small nucleated cell surrounded by a clear halo, a second larger ingested nucleated cell and fragments of nuclear debris. The surrounding marrow shows red cells, granulocytic precursors and scattered small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis. Hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis and must be interpreted with clinical and laboratory criteria; in this patient it occurs in the setting of Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophage with apoptotic debris
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear fragments rather than intact whole hematopoietic cells in phagocytic vacuoles.
Emperipolesis shows intact cells moving within the cytoplasm without phagocytic vacuoles, typically in Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes or megakaryocytes.
Megakaryocytes have a large multilobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, with passenger cells not enclosed in digestive vacuoles.
Storage histiocytes have cytoplasm filled with lipid or ceroid material without ingested nucleated cells.
